def place_on_zone_v1(obj_name, zone_name):
    # Observe current state
    obs = observe()
    obj = obs["objects"][obj_name]
    zone = obs["zones"][zone_name]
    center = zone["center"]
    half_size = zone["half_size"]
    
    # Check if the zone is occupied by any object other than the one to be placed
    occupied = False
    for name, other_obj in obs["objects"].items():
        if name == obj_name:
            continue
        # Check if other_obj is within the horizontal bounds of the zone and above it
        if (abs(other_obj["center"][0] - center[0]) < half_size[0] and
            abs(other_obj["center"][1] - center[1]) < half_size[1] and
            other_obj["top_z"] > center[2] + 0.005):
            # Move the occupying object to a temporary location (e.g., purple_box)
            temp_zone = obs["zones"]["purple_box"]
            place("purple_box", dx=0.02, dy=0.02)
            wait(20)
            occupied = True
            break
    
    # If not occupied, proceed to pick and place
    if not occupied:
        grasp_height = 0.02
        yaw = obj["long_axis_yaw"]
        pick(obj_name, grasp_height, yaw)
        wait(20)
    
    # Place the object on the target zone
    place(zone_name)
    wait(20)
